text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I happen to bump into Gold Ship while walking around the academy.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Grr! Man, I'm sooo mad!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "What's wrong," you ask? What isn't?! It all started with Jordan…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Dating Hot Spots for You and Your Boo ☆? Why would you of all people need to read something like that?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Um, excuse you. You are the last person I wanna hear that from.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Nuh-uh, excuse you! I can totally get a date!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: No chance. Like, I'd even bet my new polish on it.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Them's fightin' words, sister! I could go on the perfect date if I put my mind to it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You've got nothing better to do, right, Trainer? Come on, we're going out, right now!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yes! And I'm gonna rub how easy going on a date is right in Jordan's stupid face!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before I manage to get another word in, she drags me out by the collar…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: First, set the mood by shopping in a fancy part of town! ♪

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: …is what the magazine says. So, here we are.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: For the fancy part of town, this place looks a bit… dilapidated.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Well, there's gotta be something fun around here… Oh!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Look over there, Trainer! Isn't that awesome?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: At that super energetic shrimp at the fishmonger's over there! It looks like it's about to leap out of the tank any second!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Well, that's one way to set a mood, all right. Just what in the world will be in store for me next?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Take it easy at a nice cafe once you're all shopped out. ♪ Now that's advice I like!
choice_data_list: You realize this is a ramen shop, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yep! What's the problem? Ramen is pretty much a drink, anyway. Ipso facto, a ramen shop is a cafe!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: One order of pork ramen with firm noodles, barista man!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My rather unique "date" with the peppy Gold Ship continues full steam ahead.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Go on a moonlit walk in the park to end the night on the perfect note. ♪"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Forget the walk! Let's up the ante with some moonlit soccer! Let's gooo!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Transcendent Pandemonium Kick! Followed by a Mental Break Shot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoosh!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Awww yeah!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: See how the ball went down the slide perfectly?! This match is mine!
choice_data_list: (No way a rule like that exists…)
(No way a rule like that exists…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's been several hours since we started our "date," but I'm still not sure that's the right label for whatever is going on…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whew… I'm spent. So, what now?
choice_data_list: I'll go buy us some drinks.
Overtime! I won't quit until I win!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: You read my mind! Get me a cola, hold the carbonation.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Aaah… Today was fun, not gonna lie.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Setting the "date" part aside, I really did enjoy our time together.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Full disclosure, I've been taking pics all day as mementos. See? Here's the shrimp… and our ramen… and our soccer match.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I wonder what Jordan'll say tomorrow when I show her these beauties?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I have a feeling she won't consider our day an actual date.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Put another way, Gold Ship and I might be the only ones who can understand how much fun we had today.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh, by the way, I'll be sure to send you the 120 continuous burst shots I took of the shrimp later.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: They're preeetty awesome shots, if I say so myself. I can't hog 'em all to myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sure enough, my phone buzzes well into the night as the 120 "awesome" shots of the shrimp flood my phone.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh, now you're talking! All right, I'm game! You kick off this time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I zero in on the ball. Then, I focus all my energy into my leg and… kick!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoosh!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whoooa!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: The ball's stuck in the slide like a glove! I don't think it'll ever come unstuck now!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: That was awesome! No way I can beat that! I hate to admit it, but you take home the win today, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I don't have a clue what rules Gold Ship's game runs on, but I still feel quite pleased to be the winner.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Phew! I had a real blast today. That soccer match of ours was the funnest thing of all, though.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I think back on the shrimp at the fishmonger's and how we ended up having a soccer match at a playground, despite being decidedly outside the intended age range.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Anyone else would surely call us weird, but letting loose and just enjoying ourselves is the definition of my relationship with Gold Ship.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Dates sure are fun. We should do this again. Next time, we can play crimson hellflame soccer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I nod at Gold Ship, and the two of us gaze up at the stars.
